tweaks.summary: This app's Xposed hooks: hidden settings, dock pins, casting fixes.

tweaks.name: Meta app auto-updates blocked
tweaks.summary: Fix 08: the OCMS hook stops Meta's apps updating themselves. OCMS itself must stay enabled.
tweaks.author: Bubbagum88
tweaks.check: S=$(sh /data/adb/modules/zygisk_vector/cli scope ls org.codeberg.anonymous950.questenhancer); E=$(pm list packages -e com.oculus.ocms); case "$S" in *com.oculus.ocms*) echo "in scope";; *) echo "not in scope";; esac; case "$E" in *com.oculus.ocms*) echo "OCMS enabled";; *) echo "OCMS DISABLED";; esac

tweaks.name: Status LED colour
tweaks.summary: The current red, green and blue values of the status LED (0 to 255).
tweaks.author: community (mlsplays, FreeXR, Juspertinry)
tweaks.check: for c in red green blue; do echo "$c $(cat /sys/class/leds/$c/brightness)"; done
